title: Private Walking Food Tour In Detroit With Secret Food Tours
blurb:
On your Secret Food Tour: Detroit, you’ll explore the beating heart of
Motor City.

Your experienced guides will lead you on a rich journey through the
heart of Detroit, home to incredible history, diverse cultures, and a
thriving food scene boasting many of the cities favorite local eats.
Along the way, you'll indulge in classic comfort foods, local staples,
and the iconic dishes Detroit is known for. As you enjoy each dish,
you'll discover how the city became one of the largest and richest
cities in America fueled by the hearty classic dishes that make up the Motor City's food scene today. From the titans of industry who
occupied Detroits famed skyscrapers, to the beloved working-class
heroes that built the cars that got America moving, and the rich
immigrant communities that sought their fortunes in Detroit-communities made their mark on the cities iconic foods that you'll experience on your dive into the true flavors of Motown.

As a private Tour everything works around you!
